$comment: Lock file for vendored skills. Each entry is copied byte-for-byte from `repo`/`path` at `rev` (plus the upstream license). tools/vendor.py keeps it honest; the weekly upstream-sync workflow proposes new revs as reviewable pull requests.

skills.name: design-taste-frontend
skills.why: The repository's default skill: design direction and a pre-flight checklist that keep generated landing pages and portfolios from looking templated. Its twelve sibling skills overlap in trigger words, so only this one is vendored.

skills.why: Token-efficient browser automation and Playwright test work through the playwright-cli tool (install it with npm i -g @playwright/cli).

skills.name: grilling
